data.summary: 거래 ID를 수신했음을 통보했고(보고), 이전에 약속한 복구 요청 심사(거래 ID 확인 후 검토)를 유지함. 심사 소요 기간으로 "The review will take 3 business days."라고 안내했으며, 심사 완료 후 이메일로 통지하겠다고 약속함.

messages.text: What documents do I need to recover my account? How long will the review take? What is my case reference number?
Please provide the transaction ID from your purchase receipt. Do not send your password or verification codes. After we verify the transaction ID, we will review your recovery request.
We received your transaction ID. The review will take 3 business days. Your account has not been restored yet. We will email you after the review.
